== Notes ==

* Out of 16 kills, Drosco has dropped [[A Sealed Letter]] three times and [[Order of Thunder (Drosco)|Order of Thunder]] zero times.

* 2019-12-18: Out of eight kills or so, Drosco dropped the letter every time, and the Order of Thunder once.

* 2020-04-28: Camped this for about 10 hours today on Green before I got the order. 17 spawns were the place holder. 10 spawns were Drosco. Drosco dropped nothing 6 times, the sealed letter 3 times, then finally the order.
